definitions.explanation: The state or moment of having just woken up. Describes the groggy period immediately after waking from sleep.

definitions.gloss: sleeping and waking, daily life in a place
definitions.explanation: The routine of sleeping and getting up, often used to describe where one lives or stays.

examples.japanese: {寝起|ねお}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
{寝起|ねお}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}られたくない→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I don't want people to see my face right after waking up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寝起|ねお}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{目覚|めざ}まし→目覚まし：08550_mezamashi⟧なし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{起|お}きられる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: He wakes up easily, so he can get up without an alarm.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{寝起|ねお}き⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I live here (sleep and wake here).

examples.japanese: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アパート→アパート：01012_apaato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{寝起|ねお}き⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: During my student days, I was living at a friend's apartment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{寝起|ねお}き⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Three people were living in a small room.

notes:
USAGE:
The most common usage is in the phrase {寝起|ねお}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧／⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧, describing whether someone wakes up easily or with difficulty.
In sense 2, {寝起|ねお}き takes ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb meaning to sleep and get up (i.e., to live or stay somewhere).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寝起|ねお}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ — to be a good waker, to wake up easily
- {寝起|ねお}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ — to be a bad waker, to have trouble waking up
- {寝起|ねお}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ — face just after waking
- {寝起|ねお}き⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to sleep and wake (live somewhere)
